insecure.description: Allow insecure HTTPS client. This can also be set as the ISE_INSECURE environment variable. Defaults to `true`.

password.description: Password for the ISE instance. This can also be set as the ISE_PASSWORD environment variable.

url.description: URL of the Cisco ISE instance. This can also be set as the ISE_URL environment variable.

username.description: Username for the ISE instance. This can also be set as the ISE_USERNAME environment variable.
